content: For individuals with stable coronary artery disease (CAD) or peripheral artery disease (PAD), the use of combination therapy, such as aspirin alongside low-dose rivaroxaban, is recommended to reduce the risk of adverse cardiovascular and limb-related events. In patients with diabetes who are at high risk and have PAD, low-dose rivaroxaban has demonstrated superior efficacy compared to aspirin alone in decreasing the incidence of major cardiovascular events.
